jobs_results.title: Founding Engineer, Backend
jobs_results.description:
Scalio is building an AI marketing team for millions of small businesses. We’re looking for people who take ownership, build thoughtfully, and turn their work into measurable customer outcomes.




Founding Engineer, Backend




Scalio | Bengaluru, India | On-site | Full-time




Compensation: ₹30–60 LPA annual fixed salary plus equity. Equity terms discussed during hiring.







The role




Own foundational backend systems for Scalio’s AI marketing product. Work closely with the founders to turn ambiguous product needs into reliable services, make architectural decisions, and establish engineering practices that help a small team ship quickly.




What you’ll work on




• APIs, data models, asynchronous jobs, and integrations supporting marketing workflows.




• Reliable orchestration of generation jobs and external services.




• Authentication, access control, usage tracking, and billing integrations.




• Performance, observability, incident diagnosis, and operational tooling.




• Architecture and implementation from early design through production.




What we’re looking for




• 4+ years of software engineering experience and strong backend fundamentals.




• Evidence of independently building and operating production systems.




• Practical experience with relational databases, queues, retries, and concurrency.




• Sound judgment about reliability, delivery speed, and architectural complexity.




• Clear communication and comfort working directly with founders.




Strong plus




Early-stage startup ownership, AI product infrastructure, payments integrations, cloud operations, and effective use of AI coding tools.







Required written questions




1. Describe a backend you built from an early stage into production. What did you personally own, what scale did it reach, and which architectural decision mattered most?




2. Share a repository, product, technical article, or other relevant work. Which parts did you build?




3. How would you design a generation workflow that may take several minutes and calls an unreliable external provider? Cover job state, retries, duplicate requests, and recovery.




4. Describe a production incident you personally resolved. How did you find the cause and prevent recurrence?




5. Give an example of an ambiguous requirement you turned into a shipped system. What tradeoffs did you make?




6. Describe a decision where you deliberately chose a simpler architecture. What did you defer, and what would trigger a redesign?







Application — all six answers required




Apply through our Google application form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSft_tSA5YnlqrgLbnvKP8RKwg-E1AJyB6GNYdflBF8zYPfRKA/viewform?usp=header




Provide your name, email, phone number including country code, résumé/CV link, relevant experience, availability to work full-time on-site in Bengaluru, and answers to all six questions above. Include relevant links and clearly explain your personal contribution. Use concrete examples; generic answers will not stand out. Please omit confidential employer or customer information.




We care more about demonstrated work and results than degrees, company names, or familiarity with every tool.

jobs_results.title: Backend Developer (Kerala)
jobs_results.description:
Join Data Eminence as a remote Backend Developer and help build secure, scalable, and reliable backend systems that power contemporary web applications. You will work on server-side logic, APIs, databases, authentication, integrations, and application performance.

The ideal candidate has a strong foundation in backend development and enjoys solving technical problems. This role provides hands-on experience with real-world APIs, database systems, backend architecture, testing, deployment, and collaboration with frontend and product teams.

Full Description

At Data Eminence, we build technology solutions that require dependable backend infrastructure and well-designed APIs. As a Backend Developer, you will work closely with frontend developers, product managers, and other team members to design, develop, test, and maintain backend services and applications.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Develop and maintain scalable server-side applications and services.
- Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs.
- Implement business logic and backend functionality based on product requirements.
- Work with relational and NoSQL databases.
- Design database schemas and write efficient queries.
- Implement authentication, authorization, and access-control mechanisms.
- Integrate third-party APIs and external services.
- Develop CRUD operations and data-processing workflows.
- Validate API requests and handle errors securely and efficiently.
- Write unit and integration tests for backend functionality.
- Debug and troubleshoot application and API issues.
- Optimize backend performance, database queries, and API response times.
- Use Git and GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
- Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
- Assist with deployment, monitoring, and production troubleshooting.
- Maintain technical documentation for APIs, services, and backend processes.
- Collaborate with frontend developers to ensure smooth API integration.
- Stay updated with modern backend technologies and development practices.

We believe in learning by doing. You will gain practical experience with Node.js, Express.js, REST APIs, TypeScript/JavaScript, databases, SQL, Prisma/ORMs, authentication, Git/GitHub, Docker, cloud deployment, API testing tools, and AI-assisted development tools.

This is a hands-on backend development role where you will work on real APIs and application functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, optimize systems, and develop the skills required to build production-ready backend services.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
- 02 years of experience in backend development or relevant projects.
- Strong understanding of backend programming concepts.
- Familiarity with Node.js, Express.js, Python, Java, or another backend technology.
- Understanding of RESTful APIs and HTTP methods.
- Basic knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
- Familiarity with MongoDB or other NoSQL databases is a plus.
- Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts.
- Familiarity with Git and GitHub.
- Basic understanding of API testing using tools such as Postman.
- Knowledge of Prisma or another ORM is a plus.
- Familiarity with Docker and cloud deployment is a plus.
- Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
- Good communication and teamwork abilities.
- Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively in a remote environment.

Benefits

- Competitive salary based on skills and experience.
- Fully remote work flexibility.
- Paid time off and holidays.
- Professional development and learning opportunities.
- Company-provided equipment where applicable.
- Exposure to modern backend and AI-powered development tools.
- Opportunities to work on real-world software applications and APIs.
- Supportive and collaborative remote work environment. .

jobs_results.description:
📢 We’re Hiring: Junior Full-Stack Developer – Web, Mobile & IoT Applications




📍 Location: Amravati, Maharashtra

💼 Experience: 1–2 years

🏢 Employment: Full-time, on-site




We are looking for a hands-on Junior Full-Stack Developer to build digital applications supporting our environmental-monitoring and technology products.




The selected candidate will work on real-world product applications, including live monitoring dashboards, mobile applications, product interfaces, websites and internal digital tools.




Key responsibilities:




• Develop responsive web applications and data dashboards

• Build interfaces for viewing live and historical monitoring data

• Develop mobile applications supporting connected products and field users

• Build and integrate APIs, databases and backend services

• Integrate applications with instruments and connected devices through available communication protocols

• Develop features such as user authentication, role-based access and device management

• Build data visualisations, reports, alerts and downloadable summaries

• Support location-based information, field-data collection and device status monitoring

• Develop and maintain company and product websites

• Test, debug, deploy and maintain web and mobile applications

• Troubleshoot application, database and integration issues

• Work closely with electronics, firmware, product-development and R&D teams

• Maintain clean code, technical documentation and version control

• Implement appropriate application-security and data-protection practices




Required profile:




• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Electronics or a related field

• 1–2 years of hands-on software-development experience

• Good understanding of frontend and backend development

• Experience developing responsive web applications

• Working knowledge of REST APIs, databases and user authentication

• Familiarity with Git and structured software-development practices

• Ability to independently understand requirements, build features and troubleshoot problems

• Strong ownership, logical thinking and willingness to learn




Preferred technical exposure:




• React, Next.js, Angular or Vue.js

• Node.js, Python, FastAPI, Django or similar backend technologies

• MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or other databases

• Flutter, React Native, Android or cross-platform mobile development

• Charts, maps, dashboards and data-visualisation libraries

• Cloud deployment and basic server management

• Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, IoT or device-to-application integration

• Real-time data handling, notifications and reporting systems

• AI-assisted development tools and modern development workflows




Candidates who have independently built and deployed applications, dashboards, mobile apps or connected-device projects will be preferred. Personal projects, freelance work, internships and strong GitHub portfolios may also be considered as relevant evidence of ability.




This is a full-time, on-site position in Amravati. Candidates should apply only if they are currently based in Amravati or are genuinely willing to relocate.




Interested candidates may send:




1. Updated CV

2. GitHub, portfolio or deployed-project links

3. Brief description of applications personally developed

4. Current location, notice period and compensation expectations




Applications may be sent to keshav@plastisurge.com with the subject: “Application – Junior Full-Stack Developer”.
